title: Global Vitrola Lounge Seating — Lounge, Sofa & Ottoman
body_html:
A finely tailored take on 19th-century French Empire styling, simplified for the way institutions work today.

Vitrola pairs swooping upholstered arms and piped detailing with clean, modern proportions, giving reception and lounge areas a polished anchor. Choose from a standard lounge chair, a high-back lounge, two- and three-seat sofas, and a coordinating ottoman, each fully upholstered and standing on tapered maple wood legs. Built in Canada to contract-grade standards, every model arrives fully assembled and ready to place.

Key features

  • Transitional French Empire-inspired silhouette with swooping arms
  • Five models: standard lounge, high-back lounge, two-seat and three-seat sofa, plus matching ottoman
  • Fully upholstered with piping detail at the base of the frame
  • Fixed or sewn-tight seat cushions for a tailored finish
  • Standard tapered maple wood legs
  • Ships fully assembled

Who it’s for

Reception areas, waiting rooms, and soft-seating lounges in healthcare, municipal, and education environments that need contract-grade comfort with a refined, tailored look.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
